summary: Per a Cryptobriefing report shared by tokens_xyz, nearly 91% of tokenized stocks are issued outside the US, with Jersey, Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) and the British Virgin Islands (BVI) leading as issuance jurisdictions. The stat points to regulatory arbitrage, with tokenized-equity issuers favoring offshore and UAE free-zone frameworks over US securities rules. It matters because it positions these three jurisdictions as the dominant domiciles for tokenized stocks and underscores how marginal the US is in this market segment.
